snippet.title: It Rained All Morning ☔ Riddle #3 Answer + Riddle #4: Every Label Is Wrong #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's answer: Person 1 lied. It had been raining heavily since sunrise, so nobody was reading in the garden the whole time.

Riddle #4: Three boxes. One has only apples, one only oranges, one has both. Person 1 labelled them Apples, Oranges and Mixed, but EVERY label is wrong. You may take one fruit from one box, without looking inside. Which box do you pick from, so you can fix all three labels?

Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. 🌅

#riddle #brainteaser #logicpuzzle #puzzle #shorts
